versions.content: Semantics of FlatInstanceDescriptor.dataPrototype and FlatInstanceDescriptor.bswImplementation In case that an Au- tosarDataPrototype of a BswInternalBehavior needs to be referenced by the FlatInstanceDescriptor the usage of the FlatInstanceDescriptor. ecuExtractReference is not possible since the BswImplementation cannot be defined as a context reference. In this case the plain references FlatIn- stanceDescriptor.dataPrototype and FlatInstanceDescriptor.bswIm- plementation shall be used instead. The BswInternalBehavior in which the AutosarDataPrototype is defined can be followed via the BswImplementation. behavior reference.
